svg.title: Chromalect v0.3 color palette
svg.desc: 513 component colors chosen for perceptual and contextual separation. First 40 original colors frozen. Not a character glyph renderer.
svg.text: v0.3 · 513 unique colors · 40 original colors unchanged · 473 optimized
